SELECT
    h.SalesOrderID,
    h.OrderDate,
    h.CustomerID,
    h.TotalDue,
    d.ProductID,
    d.OrderQty,
    d.UnitPrice,
    d.LineTotal
FROM SalesOrderHeader1 h
JOIN SalesOrderDetail d
ON h.SalesOrderID = d.SalesOrderID;
